subject: re-st
title: RE.ST.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 128 (ALT(FT)II-22). RE-ST (restructuralism) is the subject; TR (transformation) is the partner. The arrow points to an unlabeled dot at the left end of the main line; RE-ST is taken from the title. From the subject: INFO-DY, PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From INFO-DY: CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism). From PROG-CONT: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: ACT-T (actual terms). From T-C-IMP: a second INFO-DY label. From the second INFO-DY: STF (source transfer). From STF: RE-DIF (redefinitions), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
